phase.title: Onboard workspace images and installed tooling

summary:
Phase 10 complete. Added `renovate.json`, the weekly/manual workspace image evidence workflow, and `docs/dependency-automation.md`; linked guidance from README/AGENTS and staged read-only Dockerfile annotations in `tmp/dependency-automation/proposed/ai-agent-sandbox.patch`.

Validation passed: Node v24.20.0/npm 11.19.0, strict Renovate schema, credential-free extraction of 16 dependencies from 13 files, actionlint, Compose config, staged patch application, Dockerfile build check, exact Ubuntu 24.04 amd64/arm64 index verification, fresh no-cache amd64 build, and Trivy 0.74.0 inventory/vulnerability scans. Trivy identified 481 OS packages plus Node 24.20.0, Zulu 25.0.4.1, and Go 1.24.1.

The workflow preserves digest-only Ubuntu syntax, uses scan UID/GID 10001 to avoid the base image’s existing 1000 account, does not start or push the image, and keeps scanner caches out of seven-day artifacts. Checksum-coupled tools require dashboard approval; Go remains amd64-only; unversioned apt/global packages and VIA remain documented gaps. GitHub-backed lookups, hosted network validation, Actions cost review, activation, and settings evidence remain pending Phase 12 per `docs/dependency-automation.md`. Whole-worktree `git diff --check` still reports unrelated pre-existing trailing whitespace in `ai-agent-sandbox/scripts/codex-lean.sh`; all phase-scoped checks pass.
